title: SS27 Girls' Playground Pop
summary: Bold, joyful colour for girls: bright prints, reversible dresses, sparkle and character pieces that girls choose themselves.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Poco Blush showed bold hues, a reversible printed dress and a scented T-shirt <sup>[1]</sup>. The Pirouette Disco Pool Party Runway promised "bold looks, sparkling details, and positive vibes" <sup>[2]</sup>. Junior Style saw a growing whimsical trend <sup>[3]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to girlswear, roughly ages 4 to 14.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Reversible and loose dresses.
- Bike shorts and oversized tees.
- Sets.

products: - Printed dresses, sets, party tops, accessories.
design_implications:
- Line sequins; check edges.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
